title: Sprint Change Proposal — Catalog Model Inversion (GTM = Read-Only Directory)
summary: Inverts the 2C.2 catalog decision: creative-work (type enum) becomes the catalog of record and movie/play are retired, for a read-only GTM directory.
notes: Manifest declared type ADR, applied as authoritative. Content is a sprint change proposal (YAML status: approved), not an ADR with Accepted status, so locked is false.
